jobs.prompt: Ticket T-0042: wire the build-owns-tests rules into scope split ingest (tools/scope-commands.mjs, the --ingest path around ticketsFromStageLists and the orderTestsAfterBuild call). T-0040 (tools/ticket-manifest.mjs: build tickets own listed tests; criticalPathLength) and T-0041 (tools/wiring.mjs: orderTestsAfterBuild leaves build tickets that own tests unchained, with notes) are already on this branch. Acceptance: (1) scope split --ingest accepts a build ticket that lists tests in its tests field without a separate test ticket: no refusal or wiring gap is raised only because a build ticket's acceptance is proved by its own listed test file (check the acceptance-provable and wiring-gap checks in the ingest), and the T-0041 notes are printed in the ingest report. (2) The ingest report shows a shorter dependency chain than test-first splits: print 'critical path: N tickets' using criticalPathLength from tools/ticket-manifest.mjs, and when any build ticket owns its tests also 'test-first would be M' (computed by counting the chain as if each owned test were a separate test ticket after its build). Tests in tests/scope-ingest-owns-tests.test.mjs drive the ingest with temp fixtures the way tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs do. Keep every existing scope-ingest test passing. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/scope-ingest-owns-tests.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-acceptance.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-waves.test.mjs tests/scope-root-files.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
